info.title: Birava API
info.description: The Birava API for native clients. Sign in with POST /auth/token and send the token as a bearer token. Every failure is `{ error: { code, message, fields? } }`. A mutation may carry an `Idempotency-Key` header: repeating it returns the first response (marked `Idempotent-Replay: true`) with no second effect.

post.summary: Sign in and get a bearer token

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Opaque; keep it secret.

cancelledDeletion.description: True when signing in cancelled a pending account deletion.
